1.explanation: The issue is related to how menu items handle the title attribute. The `getTitle` function is responsible for generating the title text, which is then used in the `render` method to set the title attribute of menu items. This behavior is causing the redundancy and accessibility issues described in the bug report. The logic for when and how to apply the title attribute needs to be revised to accommodate the proposed solutions, such as using aria-labels or providing a configuration option to control title visibility.
1.bug_scenario: The bug involves the appearance of a title attribute on menu items, which can cause redundancy when the title is the same as the inner text. This redundancy violates WCAG guidelines and affects business users who find the title tooltip unnecessary.

The 'render' method in 'Item' class uses 'getTitle' to set the title attribute, which is the core of the issue. Modifications to these functions are necessary to implement the suggested solutions, such as using 'aria-label' or introducing a configuration option to control title visibility.
